§6Fusion Reactor§f

§aFusing light elements into heavy ones. The power output is obscene and it cannot melt down.§f

The §bFusion Reactor§f is a 15x15x5 torus multiblock cooled with §bPerfluoromethyl§f. Unlike every fission reactor, it is impossible to meltdown. The tradeoff: it costs an absurd amount of materials and needs serious power just to ignite.

§6Core Components§f:
§b•§f §bTorus§f, holds 4,000 mB fuel + 10 MHE electricity, has 4 ports for attachments
§b•§f §bKlystron§f, converts HE to KyU at 1:1, needs 50%+ charge or it throttles. If output drops below torus demand, plasma dies
§b•§f §bCollector Chamber§f, +50% byproduct rate, no power cost
§b•§f §bBreeding Chamber§f, runs all RBMK irradiation recipes using neutron flux
§b•§f §bBoiler§f, converts plasma TU to super dense steam at 200 TU/mB
§b•§f §bMHD Turbine§f, plasma to electricity directly with +35% efficiency. Needs 5 MTU/t minimum or efficiency halves
§b•§f §bCoupler§f, links two tori, feeds output plasma back as klystron input for high-tier plasmas

§6Build Cost§f: 484 BSCCO Coils, 484 Cast Steel Plates, 280 Piping Blocks, 160 Blankets, 1 Core Component, a blowtorch. Per torus.

§ePS:§f Start with a single torus and a klystron. Add couplers and MHD turbines once you can afford the BSCCO wire.
